verdict.rationale: Devin supports scheduling (cron expressions, one-time scheduling) and API-driven session creation for automated workflows, plus MCP integration for connecting external event sources/tools, which enables some rule-like automation. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated event-trigger/rule engine (e.g., 'on GitHub PR opened, do X') distinct from scheduled or API-invoked sessions, so this is more limited automation than a full rules engine.
